_help.awardOrder: Which awards may show, and their order in the Highlights carousel: 1 = shown first. 0 = never shown. Only awards actually earned show; awards never add Magic.
_help.carouselSeconds: The Highlights carousel shows one award at a time and moves on by itself after this many seconds. Higher = more time to read each one. Try 3–6.
_help.carouselPauseSeconds: After someone taps the carousel (or ◀ ▶ / a swipe), it waits this long before moving on by itself again. Try 2–5.
_help.lockdownMinDrop: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Lockdown: one turn must take at least this many moves away from ONE rival glyphling. Higher = only big squeezes count. Try 4–8.
_help.lockdownMaxAfter: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Lockdown: …and leave it with this many moves or fewer (0 = tangled it). Lower = rarer. Try 1–3.
_help.pincerMinEach: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Pincer: the MOVE and the CAST must each take at least this many moves from the same rival glyphling. Higher = rarer. Try 1–3.
_help.pincerMinDrop: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Pincer: …and together at least this many. Higher = rarer. Try 3–8.
_help.weedMaxMagic: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Weed toss: the cast scored this much Magic or less (0 = nothing). Higher = a cast that also scored a little still counts. Try 0–3.
_help.weedMinBlocked: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Weed toss: the hex it took was worth at least this much Magic to a rival next turn (their best word there, from their real hand). Higher = rarer. Try 4–10.
_help.weedMinCut: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Weed toss: …or the junk cast alone took at least this many moves from one rival glyphling. Higher = rarer. Try 3–6.
_help.walledMinMagic: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Walled garden: after your own cast shut your glyphling in a pocket no rival glyphling can reach, you made at least this much Magic in there. Higher = rarer. Try 8–25.
_help.hedgeMinOver: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Through the hedge: a scoring cast that flew over at least this many of your own seeds. Higher = rarer. Try 2–4.
_help.powerPlayMin: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Power Play: one seed made at least this many words. Higher = rarer. Try 3–4.
_help.longWordMinSmall: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Long word on the Small garden: a word of at least this many letters. Try 5–7.
_help.longWordMinLarge: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Long word on the Large garden: a word of at least this many letters. Try 5–7.
_help.bridgeMinSide: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Bridge: the seed landed inside a word with at least this many letters on EACH side of it. Higher = rarer. Try 1–3.
_help.comebackMinDeficit: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Biggest comeback: the turn that took the lead must have started at least this far behind (Magic). Higher = rarer. Try 5–15.
_help.closeCallMinAfter: PROVISIONAL — set by hand to a clearly deliberate value and checked against the sims (research/sims.md); re-tune once the beta AI personalities can play positionally. Close call: a glyphling with 1 move left (the danger cue) had at least this many after its owner's turn — and was never tangled. Higher = rarer. Try 3–8.

_help.maxMarkers: The most little markers drawn on the chart's lines (tangles first, then lead changes; the Highlights star is extra). Higher = more detail but busier; 0 = none. Try 4–8.
_help.chartDrawSeconds: When the page opens, the lines draw themselves left to right over this long. Higher = a slower reveal; 0 = they appear at once (reduce motion always does). Try 1–2.
_help.chartLineWidth: Higher = thicker, bolder lines. 3 is medium (the chart is 360 wide). Try 2–4.
_help.chartHeight: The chart never gets shorter than this; on big screens it grows to fill the page. Higher = a taller chart on small screens (the page scrolls rather than squash it). Try 180–260.
_help.pageFill: On Results and Scorecard, everything grows until the page fills this much of the screen's height (0.94 = 94%), so a big screen doesn't show a small page in empty space. Never shrinks below normal size. Try 0.85–0.97.
_help.maxZoom: A cap on that growing, so huge screens don't get giant text. 2.25 = up to 2¼ times normal size. Higher = can grow bigger. Try 1.5–2.5.

_labels.carouselPauseSeconds: Highlights carousel: pause after a tap (seconds)

_labels.lockdownMaxAfter: Lockdown: moves it has left, at most
_labels.pincerMinEach: Pincer: moves taken by the move AND by the cast, each at least
_labels.pincerMinDrop: Pincer: moves taken in all, at least
_labels.weedMaxMagic: Weed toss: Magic the cast made, at most
_labels.weedMinBlocked: Weed toss: Magic a rival could have made on that hex, at least
_labels.weedMinCut: Weed toss: or moves it took from a rival glyphling, at least
_labels.walledMinMagic: Walled garden: Magic made inside the pocket, at least
_labels.hedgeMinOver: Through the hedge: own seeds flown over, at least
_labels.powerPlayMin: Power Play: words from one seed, at least
_labels.longWordMinSmall: Long word: letters, at least (Small garden)
_labels.longWordMinLarge: Long word: letters, at least (Large garden)
_labels.bridgeMinSide: Bridge: letters on each side of the seed, at least
_labels.comebackMinDeficit: Biggest comeback: Magic behind before the turn, at least
_labels.closeCallMinAfter: Close call: moves after escaping, at least
_labels.maxMarkers: Story chart: most moment markers on the lines
_labels.chartDrawSeconds: Story chart: time for the lines to draw in (seconds)
_labels.pageFill: Results pages: how much of the screen height to fill (0–1)
_labels.maxZoom: Results pages: biggest they may grow (times normal size)
